label: preparing
what: Possibly a surprise gathering for my forty years of service, presented to me as an eighteen-hundred great hall lighting and readiness check. Builder and innkeeper are coordinating hall arrangements and eight lanterns, with secretary arranging my attendance and innkeeper escorting me inside. The hall preparations are confirmed, but their being a concealed celebration is an inference, not something I have heard or read explicitly. There is insufficient evidence to identify any other knowing helpers.
